Liam (CSM): Hey Grace 1  quick heads up before our QBR prep: Silverline's environment ran a series of finetune jobs + embed indexing this weekend and we saw a concurrent spike that pushed them close to their monthly spend cap. Can we sync remediation before Tue?
Grace (Customer): yikes. We did run 3 trial finetune jobs and an index rebuild. We thought dev envs were isolated. Do you have numbers?
Aisha (FinOps): ballpark: added ~1.1M tokens from finetunes + 400k embedding tokens over 48h. Estimated extra cost = ~$12.6k. I posted a short breakdown to the cost dashboard.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): likely cause: finetune hyperparam loop was set to run 4 concurrent jobs by mistake. Also embed importer used `--workers=16` which hit full throughput.
Grace (Customer): oof, that's on our automation. Is there a way to stop ongoing runs and cap spend without blocking prod?
Liam (CSM): options: a) pause finetune throttle for non-prod (we can pause by label) b) set a soft daily spend cap for Silverline dev org c) offer one-time mitigation credit if product impact. Thoughts?
Aisha (FinOps): recommend b) immediately + a) for ongoing work. If they need prod unaffected we can scope to `env:dev` tag. I can draft a proposed credit amount if they need help.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can push a quick automation: `redwood route update --org silverline --filter 'env:dev' --max-daily-tokens 250000` and `redwood jobs pause --tag finetune --org silverline --env dev` 30s to apply. Also suggest adding `--concurrency=1` to their finetune controller.
quota-bot: applied quota: org=silverline filter=env:dev max_daily_tokens=250000 change_id=cfg-ff12. Job pause requested: tag=finetune status=pending.
quota-bot: job pause complete. Running finetune jobs reduced from 12 -> 1.
Grace (Customer): thank you. Please capture this on the QBR slide: root cause = uncontrolled finetune concurrency + high embed worker count. Fixes applied. Need recommended credit amount and path.
Aisha (FinOps): I'll prepare a slide: baseline run-rate, weekend delta, projected month-end with current controls, and a recommended credit (2/3 of overage) plus approval steps. ETA Mon 11am.
Liam (CSM): action list: 1) Ravi confirm automation snippets + add to customer runbook 2) Aisha produce credit recommendation slide 3) Grace confirm whether dev finetune runs should be entirely blocked during migration windows 4) I'll compile slides and include runbook link.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll add runbook snippet to their org dashboard and a 1-click toggle to enforce `--concurrency=1` on finetune controller. Will also include example CLI: `redwood jobs update --org silverline --tag finetune --concurrency 1`.
Grace (Customer): please do. Also can you include a short postmortem blurb we can share internally? We want to show traceability in the QBR.
Liam (CSM): will do. I'll draft a 3-bullet postmortem: (1) what happened (2) immediate mitigations (3) long-term guardrails (rate limits, quotas, automation checks). Draft for review Tue 10am.
Aisha (FinOps): noted. I'll also attach a one-time invoice adjustment template in the slide for the credit approval workflow.
Grace (Customer): appreciated. Thank you team.
Liam (CSM): closing loop: quotas in place, jobs paused, runbook + slides incoming. Tagging reviewers when draft is ready. :raised_hands:
